location_fine: polling station in a school building
visual_synopsis: Opens on a hand-lettered Armenian sign reading 'Electoral precinct N 3068' outside a drab Soviet-era school, then men push through the glass doors into a wood-panelled corridor where a young man in a dark collared jacket walks past voters, stops in front of a campaign poster and delivers an animated monologue straight to the handheld camera. He slaps his forehead, gestures with both hands, brushes right past the lens, and finally turns and runs off down the empty corridor.
